title: Real-Life: Museum tickets
situation: You want to visit the museum's special dinosaur exhibition with your two children, aged 8 and 13. You want to spend as little as possible. You hear the following message.
script: Narrator: Thank you for calling the Natural History Museum. General admission is fifteen dollars for adults and free for children under twelve. Tickets for the special dinosaur exhibition are sold separately. They cost ten dollars for adults and five dollars for children of all ages. However, if you buy a family pass for two adults and up to three children, you can enter both the museum and the special exhibition for forty dollars. Family passes are available only online. Tickets for individuals can be purchased online or at the entrance. On Wednesdays, admission to the museum is free for everyone, but special exhibition tickets are still required.
translation: 自然史博物館にお電話いただきありがとうございます。一般入館料は大人15ドル、12歳未満の子どもは無料です。恐竜の特別展のチケットは別売りです。大人10ドル、子どもは年齢を問わず5ドルです。ただし、大人2名と子ども3名までのファミリーパスを購入すると、博物館と特別展の両方に40ドルで入場できます。ファミリーパスはオンラインでのみ販売しています。個人のチケットはオンラインまたは入口でお買い求めいただけます。水曜日は博物館の入館料が全員無料ですが、特別展のチケットは引き続き必要です。

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Buy a family pass online.
Buy individual tickets at the entrance on a weekend.
Buy only general admission tickets.
Visit on a Wednesday and buy exhibition tickets.
questions.explanation: 水曜日なら入館は無料なので、特別展チケット(大人10ドル+子ども5ドル×2=20ドル)だけで済み最も安い。ファミリーパスは40ドル。

title: Real-Life: Lost luggage
situation: Your suitcase did not arrive at the airport. You are staying at a hotel downtown and are leaving the city in two days. You hear the following explanation at the baggage service counter.
script: Narrator: We're sorry that your bag hasn't arrived. According to our system, it was put on the wrong flight and is now in Chicago. It will be sent here on the next available flight, which arrives tomorrow evening. We can deliver it to your hotel the following morning at no charge. Alternatively, you can come back to the airport and pick it up yourself tomorrow night after nine. In the meantime, if you need to buy clothes or toiletries, keep your receipts and you can claim up to one hundred dollars from the airline. Please fill out this form with your contact details before you leave.
translation: お荷物が届かず申し訳ございません。システムによると、お荷物は誤った便に積まれ、現在シカゴにあります。次の便でこちらに送られ、明日の夕方に到着します。翌朝、無料でホテルにお届けできます。または、明日の夜9時以降に空港へお越しいただき、ご自分で受け取ることもできます。それまでの間、衣類や洗面用品を購入する必要があれば、領収書を保管していただければ、航空会社に最大100ドルまで請求できます。お帰りになる前に、この用紙に連絡先をご記入ください。

questions.question: What should you do first?
choices: Go to Chicago to get your bag.
Fill out a form with your contact details.
Buy a new suitcase.
Wait at the airport until tomorrow.
questions.explanation: 最初にすべきことは、帰る前に連絡先を用紙に記入すること。荷物の受け取りや買い物はその後。

title: Real-Life: Train to a conference
situation: You are at Central Station and need to get to a conference in Lakeside by 11 a.m. You want to avoid changing trains. It is now 9:10 a.m. You hear the following announcement.
script: Narrator: Good morning. Here is some information about trains to Lakeside. The 9:20 express train from Platform 3 has been canceled due to equipment problems. The 9:35 local train from Platform 5 will stop at all stations and arrive in Lakeside at 11:15. Alternatively, passengers can take the 9:30 rapid train from Platform 1 to Westbridge and change there to the Lakeside line, arriving at 10:40. The next express train departs at 9:50 from Platform 3 and arrives in Lakeside at 10:55. We apologize for any inconvenience.
translation: おはようございます。レイクサイド行きの列車についてお知らせします。3番線9時20分発の特急は、設備の故障のため運休となりました。5番線9時35分発の普通列車は各駅に停車し、レイクサイドに11時15分に到着します。または、1番線9時30分発の快速でウェストブリッジまで行き、そこでレイクサイド線に乗り換えると10時40分に到着します。次の特急は3番線9時50分発で、レイクサイドに10時55分に到着します。ご迷惑をおかけして申し訳ございません。

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Take the 9:35 local train.
Take the 9:50 express train.
Take the 9:30 rapid train.
Wait for the 9:20 express train.
questions.explanation: 乗り換えを避けて11時までに着くには、10時55分着の9時50分発特急が唯一の選択肢。普通列車は11時15分着で遅く、快速は乗り換えが必要。

title: Real-Life: Apartment repairs
situation: Water is leaking from the ceiling of your bathroom. You work from 9 a.m. to 6 p.m. on weekdays. You call your building manager and hear the following message.
script: Narrator: Hello, you've reached the building management office. Our office hours are from nine to five on weekdays. If you're calling about a non-urgent repair, please fill out a request form on our website, and a staff member will contact you within three business days. If you have an emergency, such as a water leak or a gas smell, please call our twenty-four-hour emergency line at 555-0199. For water leaks, we also ask that you turn off the main water valve, which is located under the kitchen sink in every apartment, until a repair person arrives.
translation: こちらは建物管理事務所です。営業時間は平日9時から5時までです。緊急でない修理のご用件は、当社ウェブサイトの依頼フォームにご記入ください。3営業日以内にスタッフからご連絡します。水漏れやガスのにおいなど緊急の場合は、24時間対応の緊急ダイヤル555-0199にお電話ください。水漏れの場合は、修理担当者が到着するまで、各部屋の台所の流し台の下にある元栓を閉めてください。

questions.question: What should you do first?
choices: Fill out a form on the website.
Call the office again tomorrow at nine.
Turn off the valve under the kitchen sink.
Turn off the valve in the bathroom.
questions.explanation: 水漏れは緊急なので、まず台所の流し台の下の元栓を閉める(その後緊急ダイヤルに電話)。元栓は浴室ではなく台所にある。

title: Real-Life: Library books
situation: You borrowed three books from the library, and they are due today. You have finished two of them but want to keep reading the third. You hear the following message from the library.
script: Narrator: This is a reminder from the City Library. Some of the items you borrowed are due today. Items can be returned at the front desk or in the return box outside the main entrance, which is available twenty-four hours a day. If you'd like to keep an item longer, you can renew it online or by phone, unless another user has reserved it. Please note that one of your books, "The Silent River," has been reserved by another user and cannot be renewed. Late returns are charged twenty cents per day per item.
translation: 市立図書館からのお知らせです。お借りになった資料の一部は本日が返却期限です。資料は受付カウンターか、正面入口の外にある24時間利用できる返却ボックスに返却できます。資料をもっと長く借りたい場合は、ほかの利用者が予約していない限り、オンラインまたは電話で延長できます。なお、お借りの本のうち『静かな川』はほかの利用者が予約しているため、延長できません。返却が遅れると、1点につき1日20セントの料金がかかります。

questions.question: The book you want to keep reading is "The Silent River." What should you do?
choices: Return all three books today.
Renew the third book online.
Return two books and keep the third without renewing it.
Call the library to cancel the other user's reservation.
questions.explanation: 読み続けたい本は予約が入っていて延長できない。延滞料を避けるには、今日3冊すべてを返却するしかない。

title: Real-Life: Gym classes
situation: You want to take a yoga class for beginners. You can attend only on weekday evenings after 6 p.m. You hear the following information at a fitness center.
script: Narrator: Here's our yoga class schedule for this month. Beginner yoga is held on Monday and Wednesday mornings at ten, and on Saturday afternoons at two. Intermediate yoga takes place on Tuesday and Thursday evenings at seven. Starting next week, we're also adding a new beginner class on Friday evenings at six thirty, taught by our popular instructor, Emma. Space in the new class is limited to fifteen people, so please sign up at the front desk in advance. All other classes do not require registration.
translation: 今月のヨガクラスの予定をお知らせします。初心者ヨガは月曜と水曜の午前10時、土曜の午後2時に行います。中級ヨガは火曜と木曜の夜7時です。来週からは、人気インストラクターのエマが担当する初心者クラスを金曜の夜6時半に新設します。新しいクラスは定員15名ですので、事前に受付でお申し込みください。ほかのクラスは登録不要です。

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Join the Tuesday evening class.
Attend the Saturday afternoon class.
Go to the Wednesday class without registering.
Sign up for the Friday evening class.
questions.explanation: 平日の夜6時以降で初心者向けなのは金曜6時半の新クラスだけ。定員があるので事前に受付で申し込む必要がある。火曜は中級。

title: Real-Life: Doctor's appointment
situation: You need to see a doctor about a skin problem. You are free only on Thursday afternoon. You call the clinic and hear the following message.
script: Narrator: Thank you for calling Greenhill Medical Clinic. Dr. Brown, our general physician, sees patients Monday to Friday from nine to five. Dr. Lee, our skin specialist, is available on Tuesdays and Thursdays, but only in the mornings. On Thursday afternoons, Dr. Lee offers online consultations by video call. To book an online consultation, please register on our website at least one day in advance. For in-person appointments, press one to speak to our receptionist.
translation: グリーンヒル診療所にお電話いただきありがとうございます。一般医のブラウン医師は、月曜から金曜の9時から5時まで診察しています。皮膚科専門医のリー医師は火曜と木曜に診察していますが、午前のみです。木曜の午後は、リー医師がビデオ通話によるオンライン診療を行っています。オンライン診療のご予約は、少なくとも前日までに当院のウェブサイトで登録してください。来院でのご予約は、1を押して受付におつなぎください。

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Register on the website for an online consultation.
Press one to book an appointment with Dr. Lee.
Visit Dr. Lee on Thursday morning.
Call back on Thursday afternoon.
questions.explanation: 皮膚科専門医のリー医師は木曜午後はオンライン診療のみ。前日までにウェブサイトで登録する必要がある。

title: Real-Life: Package delivery
situation: You missed a delivery while you were at work. You leave home at 8 a.m. and return at 7 p.m. on weekdays. You are free this Saturday. You hear the following message.
script: Narrator: Hello, this is Express Parcel Service. We attempted to deliver a package to you today, but no one was home. We can try again tomorrow between nine a.m. and noon, or between six and nine p.m. If neither time is convenient, you can collect your package from our service center, which is open on weekdays until eight p.m. and on Saturdays until noon. Please note that packages are kept at the center for only five days. Another option is to have it delivered to a convenience store near your home, but this must be arranged online by tonight.
translation: こちらはエクスプレス宅配便です。本日お荷物をお届けに伺いましたが、ご不在でした。明日の午前9時から正午まで、または午後6時から9時までに再配達できます。どちらの時間も都合が悪い場合は、サービスセンターでお荷物を受け取ることができます。センターは平日は午後8時まで、土曜日は正午まで開いています。なお、お荷物のセンターでの保管は5日間のみです。ほかに、ご自宅近くのコンビニエンスストアへの配達も可能ですが、今夜までにオンラインで手続きが必要です。

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Ask for redelivery tomorrow morning.
Go to the service center on Saturday afternoon.
Wait for the package to be delivered on Saturday.
Ask for redelivery tomorrow evening.
questions.explanation: 帰宅は午後7時なので、明日の午後6時から9時の再配達で受け取れる。土曜日のセンターは正午までなので午後では間に合わない。

title: Real-Life: Hotel check-out
situation: You are staying at a hotel. Your flight leaves at 7 p.m. today, and you want to go sightseeing until 3 p.m. You do not want to carry your luggage. You hear the following information from the front desk.
script: Narrator: Good morning. Check-out time is eleven a.m. If you'd like to stay in your room longer, late check-out until two p.m. is available for an extra thirty dollars. After you check out, we can keep your luggage at the front desk free of charge until ten p.m. Also, our shuttle bus to the airport leaves every hour on the hour from the main entrance. The trip takes about one hour. Please note that during the afternoon rush, the roads can be crowded, so we recommend taking a bus that leaves at least three hours before your flight.
translation: おはようございます。チェックアウトは午前11時です。お部屋にもっと長く滞在されたい場合は、追加30ドルで午後2時までのレイトチェックアウトが可能です。チェックアウト後は、午後10時までフロントで無料でお荷物をお預かりします。また、空港行きのシャトルバスは毎時ちょうどに正面玄関から出発します。所要時間は約1時間です。なお、午後の混雑時には道路が混むことがありますので、フライトの少なくとも3時間前に出発するバスのご利用をおすすめします。

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Pay for late check-out until two p.m.
Take your luggage with you while sightseeing.
Check out by eleven and leave your bags at the front desk.
Take the shuttle bus at five p.m.
questions.explanation: 11時にチェックアウトして荷物をフロントに無料で預ければ、3時まで手ぶらで観光でき、4時のバス(フライトの3時間前)に間に合う。

title: Real-Life: Smartphone repair
situation: The screen of your smartphone is cracked. You bought the phone 18 months ago. You need to use a phone for work every day. You hear the following explanation at a repair shop.
script: Narrator: Let me explain your options. Since your phone is more than one year old, the manufacturer's warranty no longer covers it. Screen repairs here cost one hundred and twenty dollars and usually take three to five days, because we need to order the parts. If you need a phone during that time, we can lend you a replacement phone for a small deposit. Alternatively, our express service can fix it in two hours, but it costs an additional fifty dollars and is available only for certain models. Unfortunately, your model is not one of them.
translation: 選択肢をご説明します。お使いの電話は購入から1年以上たっているので、メーカー保証の対象外です。当店での画面修理は120ドルで、部品を取り寄せる必要があるため通常3〜5日かかります。その間電話が必要でしたら、少額の保証金で代わりの電話をお貸しできます。または、特急サービスなら2時間で修理できますが、追加で50ドルかかり、一部の機種しか対象ではありません。あいにく、お客様の機種は対象外です。

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Use the express repair service.
Ask the manufacturer to repair it for free.
Have the phone repaired and borrow a replacement.
Wait three to five days without a phone.
questions.explanation: 特急サービスは対象外の機種で、保証も切れている。毎日電話が必要なので、通常修理を頼み代わりの電話を借りるのが正しい。

title: Real-Life: Concert tickets
situation: You want to buy two tickets for a concert next month. You want seats near the stage, and you have a credit card from Star Bank. You hear the following message.
script: Narrator: Tickets for the Blue Horizon concert go on sale this Saturday at ten a.m. Seats in the front section, closest to the stage, are one hundred dollars each, and seats in the back section are fifty dollars each. Holders of Star Bank credit cards can buy tickets two days early, starting Thursday at ten a.m., through a special website. During this presale, only front section seats will be available. Each customer may purchase up to four tickets. Front section seats are expected to sell out quickly.
translation: ブルー・ホライズンのコンサートのチケットは、今週土曜日の午前10時に発売されます。ステージに最も近い前方の席は1枚100ドル、後方の席は1枚50ドルです。スター銀行のクレジットカードをお持ちの方は、2日早い木曜日の午前10時から、特設ウェブサイトでチケットを購入できます。この先行販売では、前方の席のみ販売されます。お一人様4枚までご購入いただけます。前方の席はすぐに売り切れる見込みです。

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Buy tickets on the special website on Thursday.
Buy tickets at ten a.m. on Saturday.
Buy back section tickets on Thursday.
Wait until the concert day to buy tickets.
questions.explanation: スター銀行のカードがあるので、木曜日の先行販売で前方の席を買える。前方席はすぐ売り切れるので土曜日では遅い可能性がある。

title: Real-Life: Office move
situation: You are an employee at a company that is moving to a new office. You have a lot of documents in your desk that you need to keep. You hear the following announcement from your manager.
script: Narrator: As you all know, we're moving to the new office next weekend. Moving boxes will be delivered to each floor on Tuesday. Please pack any documents you want to take with you and write your name and new desk number on each box. Documents that you no longer need should be placed in the blue confidential bins, not in the regular trash. Computers and phones will be moved by the IT team, so please don't pack them. All boxes must be ready by five p.m. on Friday. Anything left in your desk after that time will be thrown away.
translation: ご存じのとおり、来週末に新しいオフィスへ移転します。引っ越し用の箱は火曜日に各階に届きます。持っていきたい書類は箱に詰め、各箱に名前と新しい机の番号を書いてください。不要になった書類は通常のごみではなく、青い機密書類用の箱に入れてください。パソコンと電話はIT チームが運びますので、梱包しないでください。すべての箱は金曜日の午後5時までに準備してください。それ以降に机に残っているものは処分されます。

questions.question: What should you do with the documents you need?
choices: Put them in the blue bins.
Pack them in boxes labeled with your name and desk number.
Give them to the IT team.
Leave them in your desk until the move.
questions.explanation: 持っていく書類は箱に詰め、名前と新しい机の番号を書く。青い箱は不要書類用で、机に残すと処分される。
